WITH candidates AS MATERIALIZED(SELECT d.id,d.version,d.title,d.url,d.published_at,d.updated_at,d.content_type,d.campus_scope,a.knowledge_category,a.radar_category,a.primary_destination,a.has_registration,a.classification_origin,d.body_format,d.rights_scope,s.id AS source_id,s.display_name,s.channel_type,s.official_status,COALESCE(a.radar_category,'unclassified') AS feed_category FROM knowledge_documents d JOIN knowledge_sources s ON s.id=d.source_id JOIN console_article_classifications a ON a.document_id=d.id WHERE 1=1 AND a.primary_destination IN('radar','unknown')),visible AS MATERIALIZED(SELECT * FROM candidates c WHERE EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM console_public_documents p WHERE p.id=c.id AND p.version=c.version)) SELECT * FROM (SELECT *,count(*) OVER(PARTITION BY feed_category) AS category_count,ROW_NUMBER() OVER(PARTITION BY feed_category ORDER BY published_at DESC,id) AS group_position FROM visible) WHERE group_position<=? ORDER BY feed_category,published_at DESC,id

WITH candidates AS MATERIALIZED(SELECT d.id,d.version,d.title,d.url,d.published_at,d.updated_at,d.content_type,d.campus_scope,a.knowledge_category,a.radar_category,a.primary_destination,a.has_registration,a.classification_origin,d.body_format,d.rights_scope,s.id AS source_id,s.display_name,s.channel_type,s.official_status,a.knowledge_category AS feed_category FROM knowledge_documents d JOIN knowledge_sources s ON s.id=d.source_id JOIN console_article_classifications a ON a.document_id=d.id WHERE 1=1 AND a.primary_destination='knowledge'),visible AS MATERIALIZED(SELECT * FROM candidates c WHERE EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM console_public_documents p WHERE p.id=c.id AND p.version=c.version)) SELECT * FROM (SELECT *,count(*) OVER(PARTITION BY feed_category) AS category_count,ROW_NUMBER() OVER(PARTITION BY feed_category ORDER BY published_at DESC,id) AS group_position FROM visible) WHERE group_position<=? ORDER BY feed_category,published_at DESC,id

SELECT d.id,d.version,d.title,d.url,d.published_at,d.source_id,d.body_status,d.rights_scope,s.display_name,c.primary_destination,c.radar_category,c.knowledge_category,c.classification_origin,c.analysis_json
 FROM console_public_documents d JOIN knowledge_sources s ON s.id=d.source_id JOIN console_article_classifications c ON c.document_id=d.id WHERE d.id=?

SELECT a.document_id,a.activity_key,a.group_key FROM article_activity_index a JOIN knowledge_documents d ON d.id=a.document_id JOIN document_article_analysis x ON x.document_id=d.id WHERE a.kind<>'notice' AND x.content_revision=d.content_revision AND x.input_hash=d.input_hash AND a.category=? AND a.starts_day>=? AND a.starts_day<=? AND EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM console_public_documents p WHERE p.id=a.document_id) ORDER BY a.starts_day,a.document_id,a.activity_key LIMIT ?
